q.line: Look at the light, climbing up the aerial
stanza: Look at the light, and all the time it's a changing
Look at the light, climbing up the aerial
Bright, white coming alive, jumping off of the aerial
All the time it's a changing, like now
All the time it's a changing, like then again
All the time it's a changing
And all the dreamers are waking

partner.line: All the time it's a changing, like then again

stanza: I haven't said a word since you been gone

I just can't believe the static coming on
You were my ground, my safe and sound
